_comment: Everything the robot can say. Same files in both conditions. After editing, run: python make_prompts.py --voice <one fixed voice> on ONE computer and commit prompts/*.wav + manifest.json. The topic questions (t1_*, t2_*) are PLACEHOLDERS - replace with the piloted questions (report Table 2). Keep the 'What do you think:' opening so every addressed question has the same form.
intro: Hello everyone, I am Reachy. I will guide your discussion today. Please share your ideas with each other.
t1_open: Let's start with something to the whole group. Where do you usually work or study best?
t1_q1: What do you think: is it better to study alone or in a group?
t1_q2: What do you think: does music help you concentrate, or does it distract you?
t1_q3: What do you think: how often should people take breaks when they work?
t1_q4: What do you think: is working from home better than working in a library or at work or school?
t1_q5: What do you think: are to-do lists actually useful while working?
t1_q6: What do you think: is it a good idea to study with friends who are not in your course?
t2_open: Let's start with something to the whole group. Where is one place in the world you would love to visit?
t2_q1: What do you think: is it better to travel alone or with friends?
t2_q2: What do you think: are holidays better when they are planned, or spontaneous?
t2_q3: What do you think: is it better to visit a big city or somewhere in nature?
t2_q4: What do you think: should you learn some of the language before you travel to a new country?
t2_q5: What do you think: is a relaxing holiday better than a busy one?
t2_q6: What do you think: what makes a place worth visiting again?
outro: Thank you all. That is the end of this discussion.
